# Organization actions

The organization plane is the customer's own Cbox account, above every environment it owns: projects, environments (and their custom domains), the team, organization keys and the keys of each environment. It is served on the platform root and resolves no environment.

Every row below is one action, reached through four doors that run the same code, with the same authorization, validation, approvals and [Audit log](../guides/activity-log.md) entry: the console, the REST API, the MCP server and the `cbox` CLI. See [Actions](../core-concepts/actions.md) for how that works and [Planes and hosts](../core-concepts/planes-and-hosts.md) for where each plane is served.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `https://api.cboxid.com/v1/organization`, `/v1/projects`, `/v1/environments`, `/v1/members`, … with `Authorization: Bearer cbid_org_…` (an organization key, whose role must also allow the action), or a team member's token from the platform root |
| MCP | `https://app.cboxid.com/mcp`, signed in as a member of the organization's team, or with an organization key |
| CLI | `cbox login` at the root, then the command below |
| OpenAPI | `https://api.cboxid.com/openapi.json`, one document for every plane — public, no key needed ([source](https://github.com/cboxdk/cbox-id/blob/main/resources/openapi/openapi.json)); every operation carries `x-action`, `x-scope` and `x-danger`. Reference: `https://api.cboxid.com/docs` |

Danger is how much harm the action can do in the wrong hands: `read` only reads; `write` changes something another write can undo; `destructive` removes or revokes; `critical` mints credentials, takes over access or changes how people sign in. MCP clients are told a destructive or critical tool is destructive, the CLI asks before running one, and an [approval policy](../core-concepts/approvals.md) keys on it.

## Environments

### <a id="environments.create"></a>environments.create

Create an environment under one of the organization's projects; with `initial_key`, also mint its first management key, returned once as `initial_key.token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/environments` → `201`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments` |
| Scope | `id:environments:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `environments:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `environments_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments create` |
| Secret | `data.initial_key.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `type` | string | no | Default `production`. One of `production`, `sandbox`. |
| `project_id` | string | no | The project (billing anchor) to create it under. Defaults to the organization's first project. At most 64 characters. |
| `initial_key` | object | no | Mint the environment's first management key in the same call. Its value is returned once, as `initial_key.token`. |
| `initial_key.name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `initial_key.scopes` | list of string | yes | The environment-key scopes it carries, for example `apis:write`. At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |
| `initial_key.expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire. |

### <a id="environments.domain.remove"></a>environments.domain.remove

Stop serving one of the organization's environments on its custom domain. Anything using that domain stops reaching it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /v1/environments/{id}/domain` (`{id}` is the `environment_id`) → `204`; was `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain` |
| Scope | `id:environments:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `environments:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_remove` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain remove <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="environments.domain.request"></a>environments.domain.request

Start serving one of the organization's environments on a custom domain: returns the DNS TXT record that proves you control it.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/environments/{id}/domain` (`{id}` is the `environment_id`) → `200`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain` |
| Scope | `id:environments:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `environments:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_request` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain request <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `domain` | string | yes | The domain, for example login.example.com. At most 253 characters. |

### <a id="environments.domain.verify"></a>environments.domain.verify

Look for the pending domain's DNS TXT record and, once it is visible, serve the environment on that domain.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/environments/{id}/verify-domain` (`{id}` is the `environment_id`) → `200`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/domain/verify` |
| Scope | `id:environments:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `environments:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `write` |
| MCP tool | `environments_domain_verify` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments domain verify <environment_id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="environments.list"></a>environments.list

List every environment the organization owns, across its projects, with each one's issuer.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /v1/environments` → `200`; was `GET /api/v1/workspace/environments` |
| Scope | `id:organization:read` (until v3.1 also accepted as `workspace:read`) and a role that may `read-environments`. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `environments_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id environments list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `page` | integer | no | The page to read, from 1. A list says `next_page` when there is one. |

## Keys

### <a id="keys.environment.create"></a>keys.environment.create

Mint a management key for one of the organization's environments, with the scopes it needs. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/environments/{id}/keys` (`{id}` is the `environment_id`) → `201`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/keys` |
| Scope | `id:environment-keys:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `keys:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_environment_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys environment create <environment_id>` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `scopes` | list of string | yes | The environment-key scopes it carries, for example `apis:write`. At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire. |

### <a id="keys.environment.revoke"></a>keys.environment.revoke

Revoke one of an environment's management keys; whatever uses it stops immediately.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /v1/environment-keys/{id}` (`environment_id` in the query) → `204`; was `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/environments/{environment_id}/keys/{id}` |
| Scope | `id:environment-keys:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `keys:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `keys_environment_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys environment revoke <environment_id> <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment_id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="keys.organization.create"></a>keys.organization.create

Mint an organization key with a role and optional scopes, never wider than the caller. The value is returned once, as `token`.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/organization-keys` → `201`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/keys` |
| Scope | `id:organization-keys:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `keys:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments` and `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `keys_organization_create` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys organization create` |
| Secret | `data.token` — shown once, never kept for an idempotent replay |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | At most 120 characters. |
| `role` | string | yes | One of `admin`, `developer`, `member`, `viewer`. |
| `scopes` | list of string, nullable | no | Narrow the key below its role. Left out, the role alone bounds it — or, minted by a key with scopes, that key's scopes. At least 1 items. |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time), nullable | no | When it stops working. Left out, it does not expire — or, minted by a key that does, expires with it. |

### <a id="keys.organization.list"></a>keys.organization.list

List the organization's keys, newest first, revoked ones included — names, roles, scopes and expiry, never their values.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /v1/organization-keys` → `200`; was `GET /api/v1/workspace/keys` |
| Scope | `id:organization:read` (until v3.1 also accepted as `workspace:read`) and a role that may `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `keys_organization_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys organization list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `page` | integer | no | The page to read, from 1. A list says `next_page` when there is one. |

### <a id="keys.organization.revoke"></a>keys.organization.revoke

Revoke an organization key, and every key it minted on either plane (organization keys and environment management keys, all the way down); whatever uses them stops immediately.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `DELETE /v1/organization-keys/{id}` → `204`; was `DELETE /api/v1/workspace/keys/{id}` |
| Scope | `id:organization-keys:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `keys:write`) and a role that may `manage-environments` and `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `keys_organization_revoke` |
| CLI | `cbox id keys organization revoke <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |

### <a id="team.list"></a>team.list

List the organization's team: each member's name, address, role and whether they reach every environment.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /v1/members` → `200`; was `GET /api/v1/workspace/members` |
| Scope | `id:members:read` (until v3.1 also accepted as `team:read`) and a role that may `read-members`. |
| Danger | `read` |
| MCP tool | `team_list` |
| CLI | `cbox id team list` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page, 1–100. Default 50. |
| `page` | integer | no | The page to read, from 1. A list says `next_page` when there is one. |

### <a id="team.remove"></a>team.remove

| Scope | `id:members:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `team:write`) and a role that may `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `destructive` |
| MCP tool | `team_remove` |
| CLI | `cbox id team remove <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |
| `roles_version` | string | yes |  |

### <a id="team.transfer_ownership"></a>team.transfer_ownership

Transfer shared organization ownership. Existing app roles are preserved; the previous owner may lose native ID access. Only the current owner, signed in, may do this.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /v1/members/{id}/transfer-ownership` → `204`; was `POST /api/v1/workspace/members/{id}/transfer-ownership` |
| Scope | `id:members:write` (until v3.1 also accepted as `team:write`) and a role that may `manage-members`. |
| Danger | `critical` |
| MCP tool | `team_transfer_ownership` |
| CLI | `cbox id team transfer_ownership <id>` |

| Input | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (path) | yes |  |
